package lessonrevision

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"sort"
	"time"
)

type Definitions struct {
	Revisions    repository.LessonRevisionRepository
	Lessons      repository.LessonRepository
	Translations repository.LessonI18nRepository
	Tasks        repository.TaskRepository
	Tests        repository.TaskTestRepository
	Files        repository.TaskFileStorageRepository
	Examples     repository.LessonExampleRepository
	Tx           repository.TransactionManager
}

func (u Definitions) Get(ctx context.Context, id string) (*domain.LessonRevision, error) {
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(id); err != nil {
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return u.Revisions.GetRevision(ctx, id)
}
func (u Definitions) SetPolicy(ctx context.Context, id string, a []domain.LessonActivity) error {
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(id); err != nil {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if err := domain.ValidateLessonActivities(a); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	lesson, err := u.Lessons.Get(ctx, id)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	tasks, err := u.Tasks.ListByLesson(ctx, id)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err = validateSources(lesson.ID, a, tasks); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return u.Revisions.SetPolicy(ctx, id, a)
}
func validateSources(id string, a []domain.LessonActivity, tasks []domain.Task) error {
	for _, activity := range a {
		switch activity.Type {
		case domain.ActivityTheoryAcknowledged:
			if activity.SourceReference.ID != id {
				return domain.ErrValidation
			}
		case domain.ActivityQuizPassed, domain.ActivityTaskPassed:
			found := false
			for _, task := range tasks {
				if task.ID == activity.SourceReference.ID && task.Status == domain.TaskStatusActive {
					found = true
					if activity.Type == domain.ActivityQuizPassed && !domain.IsAssessmentTaskType(task.Type) && task.Type != domain.TaskTypeQuizTheory {
						return domain.ErrValidation
					}
				}
			}
			if !found {
				return domain.ErrValidation
			}
		}
	}
	return nil
}
func (u Definitions) Resolve(ctx context.Context, id string) (*domain.LessonRevision, error) {
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(id); err != nil {
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	var result *domain.LessonRevision
	run := func(ctx context.Context) error {
		lesson, err := u.Lessons.Get(ctx, id)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if lesson.Status != domain.LessonStatusActive {
			return domain.ErrNotFound
		}
		tasks, err := u.Tasks.ListByLesson(ctx, id)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		sort.Slice(tasks, func(i, j int) bool { return tasks[i].ID < tasks[j].ID })
		revision := domain.LessonRevision{Schema: domain.LessonRevisionSchema, LessonID: id, Content: domain.LessonRevisionContent{Title: lesson.Title, Excerpt: lesson.Excerpt, Description: lesson.Description, Tasks: []domain.LessonRevisionTask{}}}
		if u.Translations != nil {
			revision.Content.Translations, err = u.Translations.ListByLesson(ctx, id)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		if u.Examples != nil {
			revision.Content.Examples, err = u.Examples.ListByLesson(ctx, id, true)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		for _, task := range tasks {
			if task.Status != domain.TaskStatusActive {
				continue
			}
			snapshot := domain.LessonRevisionTask{Task: task}
			if u.Tests != nil {
				snapshot.Tests, err = u.Tests.ListByTask(ctx, task.ID)
				if err != nil {
					return err
				}
			}
			if u.Files != nil {
				snapshot.StarterFiles, err = u.Files.ListByTask(ctx, task.ID)
				if err != nil {
					return err
				}
			}
			revision.Content.Tasks = append(revision.Content.Tasks, snapshot)
		}
		revision.Activities, err = u.Revisions.GetPolicy(ctx, id)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if len(revision.Activities) == 0 {
			for _, task := range revision.Content.Tasks {
				activityType := domain.ActivityTaskPassed
				if domain.IsAssessmentTaskType(task.Task.Type) || task.Task.Type == domain.TaskTypeQuizTheory {
					activityType = domain.ActivityQuizPassed
				}
				revision.Activities = append(revision.Activities, domain.LessonActivity{ActivityID: uuid.NewSHA1(uuid.NameSpaceOID, []byte(id+":"+activityType+":"+task.Task.ID)).String(), Type: activityType, Required: true, SourceReference: domain.ActivitySourceReference{ID: task.Task.ID}})
			}
			if len(revision.Activities) == 0 {
				revision.Activities = []domain.LessonActivity{{ActivityID: uuid.NewSHA1(uuid.NameSpaceOID, []byte(id+":theory")).String(), Type: domain.ActivityTheoryAcknowledged, Required: true, SourceReference: domain.ActivitySourceReference{ID: id}}}
			}
		}
		if err = domain.ValidateLessonActivities(revision.Activities); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err = validateSources(id, revision.Activities, tasks); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		// Authored task references are bound to this snapshot, never to mutable task.version.
		for i := range revision.Activities {
			if revision.Activities[i].Type != domain.ActivityPracticeCompleted {
				revision.Activities[i].SourceReference.RevisionID = ""
			}
		}
		sort.Slice(revision.Activities, func(i, j int) bool { return revision.Activities[i].ActivityID < revision.Activities[j].ActivityID })
		raw, err := json.Marshal(revision)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		sum := sha256.Sum256(raw)
		hash := hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
		revision.LessonRevisionID = uuid.NewSHA1(uuid.NameSpaceOID, []byte(id+":"+hash)).String()
		revision.CreatedAt = time.Now().UTC()
		for i := range revision.Activities {
			if revision.Activities[i].Type != domain.ActivityPracticeCompleted {
				revision.Activities[i].SourceReference.RevisionID = revision.LessonRevisionID
			}
		}
		result, err = u.Revisions.StoreRevision(ctx, hash, revision)
		return err
	}
	if u.Tx == nil {
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if err := u.Tx.WithTx(ctx, run); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return result, nil
}

// FreezeGeneratedReceipt makes request replay return the originally chosen revisions.
func (u Definitions) FreezeGeneratedReceipt(ctx context.Context, key string, bindings []domain.GeneratedLessonBinding) ([]domain.GeneratedLessonBinding, error) {
	existing, err := u.Revisions.GetGeneratedReceipt(ctx, key)
	if err == nil {
		return existing, nil
	}
	if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		return nil, err
	}
	for i := range bindings {
		revision, resolveErr := u.Resolve(ctx, bindings[i].LessonID)
		if resolveErr != nil {
			return nil, resolveErr
		}
		bindings[i].LessonRevisionID = revision.LessonRevisionID
	}
	return u.Revisions.StoreGeneratedReceipt(ctx, key, bindings)
}
